# Contributing to Ensemble

Thanks for helping improve the project.

## Before you start

- Read [`AI.md`](../AI.md) for operational rules.
- Use [`AI_MAP.md`](../AI_MAP.md) to find the right file quickly.
- Skim [`docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md) for the repo layout and documentation entrypoints.

## Workflow

1. Create a branch for your work.
2. Keep changes focused and avoid mixing unrelated cleanup with behavior changes.
3. Run `npm run validate` before opening a pull request.
4. If you changed UI behavior, also run `npm run test:e2e`.

## Good pull requests

- Include a short summary of what changed and why.
- Mention any docs or repo-structure updates explicitly.
- Call out anything that should be reviewed manually in the browser or editor.
